title: Layout Intro
slide_intent: Think of composition as putting prepared elements to work together. The cooking analogy gives the reader a familiar way into that task.
strategic_value: Instacart can explain a design process in the language of meals, connecting the book’s instruction to the brand’s subject.
demonstration: A large two-line cooking metaphor follows a small Layout Intro label on a pale field. The specific composition diagrams begin on the following page.
practical_value: Use the page to frame a layout review: identify which established elements are available before deciding how to combine them.
